profile.headline: Forward Deployed Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Hands on software/data/ml engineer, data geek, and technologist.  Started programming at age 14 when my dad purchased a second-hand Commodore 64 from my high school math teacher.  I am all about the growth mindset, and I believe that given the right environment, information, and support, there is nothing I cannot learn and apply.  I enjoy helping folks solve complex problems with software & data.  I occasionally code in my sleep.
